TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Expect significant traffic buildup on EDSA southbound from Muñoz/FPJ Avenue to Quezon Avenue in Quezon City due to closure on North Avenue, specifically from Agham Road to QC Circle. The closure is to give way to the construction of the MRT-7 line's QMC Station pedestrian tunnel by the Department of Transportation (DOTr) until November 30, 2025.

Traffic enforcers of the MMDA, Quezon City LGU, and the Philippine National Police (PNP) are managing traffic in the affected areas.

Motorists are advised to take alternate routes: 
From North Avenue: Take Sen. Miriam Defensor-Santiago Ave., Quezon Avenue, and Elliptical Road.
#mmda

Workers from NCR and Southern Tagalog, together with trade union and human rights advocates, staged a protest action at Camp Crame in Quezon City on Monday, September 29, to mark the National Day of Action against Trade Union Repression.

The groups demanded the immediate release of 277 rallyists arrested during the anti-corruption protest in Mendiola and called for justice for Eric Saber, a construction worker who was allegedly slain by state forces during the September 21 Mendiola rally. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
